abstract: Choriocarcinoma presenting in an infant or neonate is a rare entity that in the past has been uniformly fatal. The authors present the first reported case of choriocarcinoma successfully treated in a 3-week-old infant. Choriocarcinoma was not suspected in this case until pathologic examination revealed the diagnosis. In retrospect, however, the case fits well into the classic "infantile choriocarcinoma syndrome" initially described by Witzleben in 1968. Review of additional cases reported since the initial description validates Witzleben's initial observations and also indicates that the original definition should be broadened to include other significant presentations of the disease not initially appreciated, specifically anemic infants with central nervous system symptoms as well as newborns and older children. The importance of making a correct and rapid diagnosis is emphasized by the successful outcome in this case where aggressive surgery and subsequent chemotherapy have been curative. Serum beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-HCG) levels have been uniformly positive, providing easy confirmation of the diagnosis. Because the mother can also be affected, an appropriate diagnosis of the infant may also lead to more rapid diagnosis and treatment of the mother.
abstract_ja: 生後3週の乳児に発生した絨毛癌を、成功裏に治療した初めての症例を報告する。この症例では、病理検査で診断が判明するまで絨毛癌は疑われなかった。振り返ると、本症例はWitzlebenが1968年に初めて記載した古典的な「乳児絨毛癌症候群」に合致する。その後報告された症例を検討すると、Witzlebenの初期の観察は妥当であることが確認された。また、定義は当初認識されなかった他の重要な病態を含むように拡大すべきである。具体的には、中枢神経症状を伴う貧血の乳児、ならびに新生児および年長児を含むべきである。積極的な手術とその後の化学療法により治癒した本症例は、正しく迅速な診断の重要性を示している。血清β-hCG値は一貫して陽性であり、診断の確定を容易にした。母体も罹患しうるため、乳児の適切な診断は母体の迅速な診断と治療にもつながりうる。
